derivedOutputs.reason: Extract the upstream Codex config path/read/validate/file-IO helpers into a GUI-free production module; preserve source-derived algorithms, while the original desktop module reexports them.

sourceReferencePolicy: Copied upstream manuals are immutable source-reference snapshots, not published host documentation. Relative links to files outside the selected snapshot are recorded with pinned upstream URLs, not treated as local product links. Host-authored SYNC.md and LICENSING.md remain normal local documents.
dependencyPolicy: Reachable Rust modules, include/include_str/include_bytes resources, Cargo path dependencies/build scripts, TS/JS imports/exports/dynamic imports, URL resources and CSS references are inventoried. Unresolved local resources and unreviewed computed resources fail closure. Cargo metadata and the native build separately close platform-specific crate dependencies and embedded resources. Snapshot-only files are never claimed as production inputs.
